name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Llama-3.2-370B for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window is the only proven one at this scale, cutting truncation losses that hurt 70B-class models. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the capability gain outweighs it—even a 0.5% lift justifies the spend.

name: Torque
text: Llama-3.2-370B’s "proven" 128K window is only proven in Meta’s stack—our 3B model chokes on 64K inputs today, and no test shows 370B handling 128K in our pipeline. Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K window is untested but cheaper; run a 50K prompt through both and measure truncation loss—if Qwen drops less than 0.5% tokens, it wins.
